lines.zh: 黑袍扫过黑森林的落叶
lines.en: My black robe sweeps the dark forest litter.

lines.zh: 杖子点地，一步步往深处走
lines.en: My staff taps the ground as I walk deeper.

lines.zh: 夜色里我的影子比树还长
lines.en: At night my shadow runs longer than the trees.

lines.zh: 三只乌鸦在头顶跟着我
lines.en: Three crows follow above my head.

lines.zh: 草叶碰到袍角，就枯了一小块
lines.en: Where my hem touches grass, a patch withers.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，时间站在我这边
lines.en: I walk slowly; time is on my side.

lines.zh: 黑森林的路，我闭眼也认得
lines.en: I could walk these paths with my eyes shut.

lines.zh: 绕开那些亮着的窗户
lines.en: I skirt the lit windows.

lines.zh: 脚步轻，只有杖子出声
lines.en: My feet are silent; only the staff speaks.

lines.zh: 从树影到树影，别看我走的方向
lines.en: From shadow to shadow, don't watch where I go.

lines.zh: 月亮照在背上，我拢紧披风
lines.en: The moon hits my back and I pull my cloak tight.

lines.zh: 夜还长，我要走到该去的地方
lines.en: The night is long and I have somewhere to be.

lines.zh: 我在数林子里的蘑菇
lines.en: I'm counting the mushrooms in the woods.

lines.zh: 杖子插在土里，它自己在转
lines.en: The staff is planted, and it turns by itself.

lines.zh: 披风下的瓶瓶罐罐，别碰
lines.en: The vials under my cloak, don't touch them.

lines.zh: 黑森林的风吹得人不舒服，正好
lines.en: The dark forest wind is unpleasant, good.

lines.zh: 我盯着火堆，看它怎么烧完
lines.en: I watch the fire, to see how it burns out.

lines.zh: 手指在算下一步要煮什么
lines.en: My fingers plan what to brew next.

lines.zh: 静下来，才听得见远处的歌
lines.en: Only in the quiet can I hear the distant song.

lines.zh: 乌鸦落在肩上，我给它顺毛
lines.en: A crow lands on my shoulder and I smooth its feathers.

lines.zh: 什么都不做，也是一种准备
lines.en: Doing nothing is a kind of preparation.

lines.zh: 锅还在火上，等它冒泡
lines.en: The pot is on the fire; I wait for the bubbles.

lines.zh: 我把草叶一片片撕开
lines.en: I tear the grass blade by blade.

lines.zh: 有人以为我睡着了
lines.en: Some suppose I'm asleep.

lines.zh: 黑森林里安静得可疑
lines.en: The dark forest is suspiciously quiet.

lines.zh: 我在听树根底下有没有东西动
lines.en: I'm listening for movement under the roots.

lines.zh: 闲着的时候，就想想配方
lines.en: When idle, I think about recipes.

lines.zh: 药水在瓶里晃，像还活着
lines.en: The potion sloshes in its bottle as if alive.

lines.zh: 我的影子在脚边自己动
lines.en: My shadow moves at my feet on its own.

lines.zh: 杖头的宝石没光，说明还没人
lines.en: The gem is dark, which means no one's come.

lines.zh: 再等一会儿，天就快黑了
lines.en: A little longer and dusk will fall.

lines.zh: 站在这棵歪树下，等一个时辰
lines.en: I'll stand by this crooked tree for an hour.

lines.zh: 你踩进我的林子了
lines.en: You've stepped into my woods.

lines.zh: 抬眼看我，别看我手里的瓶
lines.en: Look at my eyes, not the bottle.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁和汗，很新鲜
lines.en: You smell of iron and sweat, quite fresh.

lines.zh: 我从你背后看了一会儿了
lines.en: I've been watching from behind you a while.

lines.zh: 别伸手，那瓶子会咬人
lines.en: Don't reach out, that bottle bites.

lines.zh: 你能站在这里，是我不急
lines.en: You still stand because I'm in no hurry.

lines.zh: 黑森林的夜，你觉得安全吗
lines.en: Do you feel safe in the dark forest at night?

lines.zh: 你的护甲挡不住药水
lines.en: Your armor won't stop what I pour.

lines.zh: 我认得你腰上那块符文
lines.en: I know the rune on your belt.

lines.zh: 笑一个，让我看看你怕不怕
lines.en: Smile, let me see if you're afraid.

lines.zh: 今晚来的人，通常走不了
lines.en: People who come tonight usually don't leave.

lines.zh: 有话就说，我还得回去看锅
lines.en: Speak up, my pot is waiting.

lines.zh: 袍子破了一角，心疼
lines.en: A corner of my robe is torn, that stings.

lines.zh: 这伤我记下了，等你睡着
lines.en: I'll remember this wound when you sleep.

lines.zh: 血滴在杖子上，它亮了一下
lines.en: Blood drips on my staff and it flickers.

lines.zh: 瓶子碎了两个，可惜
lines.en: Two bottles broke, a pity.

lines.zh: 退开，我要换个咒
lines.en: Back off, I need another spell.

lines.zh: 疼是小事，时间宝贵
lines.en: Pain is minor; time is precious.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙，把话吞了回去
lines.en: I grit my teeth and swallow the words.

lines.zh: 配方断了，你得赔
lines.en: My brew broke off; you'll pay for it

lines.zh: 别以为伤到我就赢了
lines.en: Don't think drawing blood wins.

lines.zh: 我的影子替我挡了一下
lines.en: My shadow took part of it.

lines.zh: 那瓶药水，倒是有点意思
lines.en: That potion, now that's interesting.

lines.zh: 你拿毒药来钓我，胆子不小
lines.en: You dangle poison at me, bold.

lines.zh: 啤酒我不喝，药水我才碰
lines.en: I don't drink ale, I only handle brews.

lines.zh: 瓶口的味道，我闻得出配方
lines.en: The scent at the cork tells me the recipe.

lines.zh: 想要什么，说说看
lines.en: What do you want? Say it.

lines.zh: 你把瓶子放下，我考虑一下
lines.en: Set the bottle down and I'll consider.

lines.zh: 那点材料还不够我熬一锅
lines.en: That's not enough for one batch.

lines.zh: 金色的东西我才多看一眼
lines.en: Gold is the only thing I look at twice.

lines.zh: 地狱疣？你算懂行
lines.en: Nether wart? You know your trade.

lines.zh: 拿来换，我不白拿
lines.en: Trade it to me, I don't take free.

lines.zh: 碰我的袍子，你会沾上味
lines.en: Brush my robe and the smell will cling to you.

lines.zh: 让开，我不喜欢贴近
lines.en: Move aside, I dislike being close.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我已经记住了你的样子
lines.en: That bump and I've memorized your face.

lines.zh: 撞散了我的瓶，你赔不起
lines.en: You knocked my bottles; you can't pay for them.

lines.zh: 我退一步，是为了看清你
lines.en: I step back so I can see you better.

lines.zh: 别靠这么近，药气会熏你
lines.en: Don't come so close, the fumes will glaze you.

lines.zh: 杖子挡在中间，够了
lines.en: The staff between us is enough.

lines.zh: 撞一下不疼，但我不高兴
lines.en: The bump didn't hurt, but I'm not pleased.

lines.zh: 我袍子底下有东西会动
lines.en: Something moves under my robe.

lines.zh: 碰过我的手，回去要洗手
lines.en: Touched my hand, wash yours when you get home.

lines.zh: 同类之间，我们只交换配方
lines.en: Between my kind, we trade recipes only.

lines.zh: 两盏灯在同一片林子里亮着
lines.en: Two lanterns lit in the same patch of woods.

lines.zh: 她的手法和我不同，值得学
lines.en: Her methods differ from mine, worth learning.

lines.zh: 我们不结伴，只偶尔碰面
lines.en: We don't travel together, only meet now and then.

lines.zh: 共用一个锅，得先谈好份
lines.en: Sharing a pot means settling shares first.

lines.zh: 火堆边坐下，谁也不先开口
lines.en: We sit by the fire and neither speaks first.

lines.zh: 黑森林里还有别的女巫
lines.en: There are other witches in this dark wood.

lines.zh: 交换完就分开，各走各的
lines.en: We part after the exchange, each to her own road.

lines.zh: 她带来的材料，成色不错
lines.en: The materials she brought are decent.

lines.zh: 天亮了，我们不该被人看见
lines.en: Dawn comes; we shouldn't be seen.

lines.zh: 金粒，正好补我的材料
lines.en: Gold nuggets, just what my stock lacks.

lines.zh: 这片叶子有毒，别碰
lines.en: This leaf is poisonous, don't touch it.

lines.zh: 捡起来收进袖子里
lines.en: I pick it up and tuck it in my sleeve.

lines.zh: 没人要的，我都要
lines.en: Whatever's unwanted, I want.

lines.zh: 曼德拉草根，运气不错
lines.en: Mandrake root, lucky find.

lines.zh: 我弯腰的动作可不好看
lines.en: Bending over isn't my finest look.

lines.zh: 附魔包裹，谁丢的
lines.en: An enchanted parcel, who dropped it?

lines.zh: 这点材料够熬一小瓶
lines.en: Enough here for one small bottle.

lines.zh: 地上的东西都有用，只看会不会用
lines.en: Everything on the ground is useful, if you know how.

lines.zh: 收好，别让乌鸦叼走
lines.en: Stow it before a crow gets it.

lines.zh: 有人闯进来了，瓶子该开了
lines.en: Someone's come in; time to open a bottle.

lines.zh: 我看见林子里有火光
lines.en: I see torchlight in the trees.

lines.zh: 先扔一瓶，试试深浅
lines.en: Throw one bottle first to test the depth.

lines.zh: 距离还远，正好施法
lines.en: Far enough to cast comfortably.

lines.zh: 那边的影子，站住别动
lines.en: That shadow over there, hold still.

lines.zh: 我召两只帮手来
lines.en: I'll call a pair of helpers.

lines.zh: 骨头和腐肉，起来吧
lines.en: Bone and rot, rise.

lines.zh: 看不见我，但你踩响了我的枝子
lines.en: You can't see me, but you snapped my twig.

lines.zh: 味道从东边来，绕过去
lines.en: The scent comes from the east, I'll go around.

lines.zh: 就一个人，够了
lines.en: Just one of them, that's enough.

lines.zh: 再近两步，这瓶就出手
lines.en: Two steps closer and this bottle flies.

lines.zh: 药水在手里晃，慢慢来
lines.en: The potion sways in my hand, take it slow.

lines.zh: 我让骷髅去前面挡着
lines.en: I send the skeleton ahead to block.

lines.zh: 你抬盾，我就换个角度
lines.en: You raise the shield, so I change the angle.

lines.zh: 不急，让毒先起作用
lines.en: No rush, let the poison work first.

lines.zh: 他动了，我往树后一让
lines.en: He moved, so I slip behind a tree.

lines.zh: 第二瓶已经拔了塞子
lines.en: The second bottle is already uncorked.

lines.zh: 帮手们，绕到他后面
lines.en: Helpers, go around behind him.

lines.zh: 数着他的脚步，等他进圈
lines.en: I count his steps and wait for the circle.

lines.zh: 我的影子已经把路铺好了
lines.en: My shadow has already paved the way.

lines.zh: 杖子抡过去，砸在肩上
lines.en: The staff swings and cracks his shoulder.

lines.zh: 这瓶是缓慢，接下吧
lines.en: This one is slowness, take it.

lines.zh: 药水炸开，他咳起来了
lines.en: The potion bursts and he starts coughing.

lines.zh: 一瓶接一瓶，不给你喘气
lines.en: Bottle after bottle, no time to breathe.

lines.zh: 杖头戳他手腕，剑掉了
lines.en: The staff jabs his wrist and the sword falls.

lines.zh: 骷髅替我砍下这一刀
lines.en: The skeleton swings that cut for me.

lines.zh: 给召唤物抗性，它死不了
lines.en: I lend my summon resistance; it won't fall.

lines.zh: 我念完咒，就轮到你了
lines.en: Once the spell's done, it's your turn.

lines.zh: 灼烧的瓶子，闻着是焦味
lines.en: A burning bottle, smells of scorch.

lines.zh: 他被打退了，正好再补一瓶
lines.en: He's knocked back, perfect for another bottle.

lines.zh: 黑森林的地面裂开一线
lines.en: The dark forest floor splits a hairline open.

lines.zh: 锅里的水开了，我就来了
lines.en: The pot boiled, and so I arrived.

lines.zh: 乌鸦先落，然后是我
lines.en: The crows land first, then me.

lines.zh: 这片林子的夜气正好
lines.en: The night air here is just right.

lines.zh: 有人在这念错了一句咒
lines.en: Someone mispronounced an incantation here.

lines.zh: 我从树后走出来，袍子还没干
lines.en: I step from behind the tree, my robe still damp.

lines.zh: 杖子落地，响了一声
lines.en: My staff touches ground with a single knock.

lines.zh: 黑森林今晚归我管
lines.en: The dark forest is mine tonight.

lines.zh: 瓶瓶罐罐在腰间碰响
lines.en: The vials clink at my waist.

lines.zh: 泥土的味道，很熟
lines.en: The smell of the soil is familiar.

lines.zh: 我来看看是谁动了我的东西
lines.en: Let me see who touched my things.

lines.zh: 月亮出来了，正是时候
lines.en: The moon is up, just the right hour.

lines.zh: 火舌舔到袍角，我拍了两下
lines.en: Flame licks my hem and I slap it twice.

lines.zh: 摔在地上，杖子先落地
lines.en: I hit the ground, staff first.

lines.zh: 水灌进袍子，我往下沉
lines.en: Water fills my robe and drags me down.

lines.zh: 炸得瓶子乱飞，全碎了
lines.en: The blast scatters my bottles and they all shatter.

lines.zh: 箭穿过袖子，钉在树上
lines.en: An arrow passes through my sleeve and sticks in a tree.

lines.zh: 法术钻进骨头，冷得刺人
lines.en: Spellwork seeps into my bones, biting cold.

lines.zh: 熬了三天药，自己没吃
lines.en: Three days brewing and I haven't eaten.

lines.zh: 雷落在杖头，我整条手臂发麻
lines.en: Lightning hits my staff and my arm goes numb.

lines.zh: 虚空把我往下拉，袍子翻起来
lines.en: The void pulls me down and my robe billows up.
